internship.working_hours: 40 hours per week, with timing agreed with Didigam Nithin (CEO)
internship.compensation: INR 20,000 per month, subject to applicable deductions and satisfactory attendance
responsibilities: Collect, clean, validate, and document datasets used for approved business and product analysis.
Build exploratory analyses, dashboards, statistical summaries, and machine-learning experiments under supervision.
Communicate assumptions, findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Protect company, client, and user information and follow all security, privacy, and responsible-AI requirements.
Participate in reviews, mentoring sessions, and final project demonstrations or handovers.
internship.equipment_and_access: Nhancio may provide accounts, repositories, datasets, or equipment needed for approved work. All access remains company property and must be returned or disabled at the end of the internship.
internship.expenses: Only expenses approved in writing before they are incurred will be eligible for reimbursement against valid receipts.
internship.completion_documents: Subject to satisfactory performance, completion of assigned work, return of company property, and compliance with this letter, Nhancio may issue an internship completion certificate. Any recommendation letter remains discretionary.

terms.leave_policy: Planned leave requires prior written approval from the reporting manager. Emergencies should be communicated as soon as reasonably possible.
terms.background_verification: This offer is subject to the accuracy of the information and documents provided by the intern and any reasonable identity, education, or background checks requested by Nhancio.
